bars.name: bar:Materials Project
bars.detail: HTTP 403 — bot-blocked to a plain fetch
bars.fix: Reachable in a real browser. Open it in the browser pane; never judge it from curl output.

queue.item: D1 CRITICAL  The foundation-model comparison picks its baseline by substring-matching the uploaded FILENAME for 'off'/'organic', so a periodic crystal named e.g. offcut.cif is compared against MACE-OFF. That crosses two incompatible energy conventions (-1..-15 vs -100..-600 eV/atom) and the delta it prints is meaningless.  [app/calculate/page.tsx ~259]

D2 HIGH  The validator is absent from the deployed container: mace-api/Dockerfile's build context is mace-api/, so `COPY . .` cannot reach ../test_scripts/. Hosted results report validation.status 'unavailable' — degrading correctly, but degraded. The live site runs without the scientific gate the repo advertises.  [mace-api/Dockerfile]

D3 HIGH  code.gitCommit is null in the deployed container because there is no .git in the image, so the live provenance manifest cannot pin the code that produced a result. NOMAD stamps nomad_version and nomad_commit into every public entry at build time; SimpleAtom only manages it locally.  [mace-api/provenance.py git_info(), mace-api/Dockerfile]

D4 MEDIUM  mace-api/main.py returns HTTP 500 instead of 400 for a rejected calculationType, so the hosted FastAPI path reports a server fault for what is correct input validation. The refusal itself works; only the status is wrong.  [mace-api/main.py]

D5 MEDIUM  Geometry-opt trajectories contain a duplicated frame 0 with off-by-one step labels, so the result message and the trajectory it ships contradict each other.  [mace-api/calculate.py _run_geometry_opt]

D6 MEDIUM  Upstream computes stress on every call and SimpleAtom discards it; properties.pressure is declared in the type and never populated. Materials Project shows a unit on every value it prints — a declared field that is always null is the opposite of that.  [mace-api/calculate.py, types/mace.ts]

D7 MEDIUM  lattice and properties.volume are declared non-nullable in TypeScript but the backend sends null for both on non-periodic systems. The type asserts something the API does not guarantee.  [types/mace.ts, mace-api/calculate.py]

D8 MEDIUM  ASE's get_temperature() divides by 3N even with centre-of-mass momentum pinned, so reported MD temperature reads about 11 percent low for a 9-atom molecule. The MD chart shows it as-is, with no note.  [mace-api/calculate.py MD path, components/calculate/trajectory/]

D9 MEDIUM  The force-arrow scale silently differs between models — 0.82 vs 1.0 A per eV/A on the same geometry — so two results for one molecule render non-comparable arrow lengths with no indication of the change.  [components/calculate/molecule-viewer-3d.tsx]

D10 MEDIUM  21 interactive targets are under 44x44 and nav links are 17px tall, so the site fails the platform minimum touch target on mobile. Partly addressed inside the viewer; unaddressed elsewhere.  [site-wide; components/site-header.tsx]
D11 LOW  Force arrows are drawn for hidden C-H hydrogens, leaving arrows with no visible atom at their base.  [components/calculate/molecule-viewer-3d.tsx]

D12 LOW  components/ui/card.tsx CardHeader is a bare grid with no explicit columns unless a CardAction child is present — the same unsafe pattern that caused the /calculate mobile overflow, one level deeper. ResultsSkeleton has it too, currently inert.  [components/ui/card.tsx]
D13 LOW  The green selection shell in the viewer is nearly invisible — delta-G of only +2 while R and B drop 13.  [components/calculate/molecule-viewer-3d.tsx]

D14 LOW  Installed mace-torch is 0.3.15 while the reference-conformance bar is pinned at ACEsuit/mace v0.3.16, so conformance findings are being judged against a version the local environment is not running.  [requirements.txt, local env]
D15 LOW  Audit findings 6, 9 and 12 from docs/v2/audit-vs-acesuit.md were never closed out. Findings 7, 10 and 11 are recorded as done.  [docs/v2/audit-vs-acesuit.md]
